approach: Instead of attaching exactly one generic listener per final_setup_done, attach listeners uniquely identified by a qualified object id and ensure removal happens atomically—installing once per target scope and cleaning up afterwards guarantees only the intended target’s callback fires, preventing both premature invocation and missing registration.
hypothesis: When setting up systems recursively via final_setup, the top‑level Problem’s last child subsystem triggers its own final_setup early due to depth‑first traversal, installing the ‘final_setup_done’ event handler on the sub‑problem; later, when the parent finishes, its already installed handlers fire again and control returns via sys.exit inside the handler attached to the sub‑problem.
